notes.title: Automatic save system and Gamepad support
notes.content:
Disminal Update: Location Saving & Gamepad Support

🗂️ Automatic Location-Saving System
You no longer have to worry about losing your progress—Disminal now features an automatic location-saving system. The game will remember where you left off, so you can jump back in and continue playing.

🎮 Gamepad/Joystick Support
You can now play Disminal using a gamepad. While it's only been tested with a Logitech joystick so far, it should work with most standard gamepads. If you run into any bugs, compatibility issues, or have suggestions, please drop a comment and let me know

BLACK BARS MOSTLY REMOVED, 4:3 ratio is now supported.

GAMEPAD BINDINGS:
R1/RB -> Hold to walk faster
L1/LB -> Toggle Zooming (if pressed again it will zoom out/in while held)
LT/RT, L2/R2 -> Hold these for crouching
A / X → Interact

Thank you for playing and supporting my first game, and apologies for taking so long to add these much-needed fixes!
